title: Application Level Protocols
subtopics: FTP – File Transfer Protocol (active and passive modes)
HTTP methods: GET, POST, PUT, DELETE, HEAD

definitions.definition: Simple Mail Transfer Protocol – standard for sending email
Post Office Protocol – retrieves email from a mail server
File Transfer Protocol – transfers files between client and server
Trivial File Transfer Protocol – simplified file transfer over UDP
HyperText Transfer Protocol – foundation of data communication on the Web
Secure Shell – encrypted replacement for Telnet

learning_objectives: Describe the purpose and operation of major application-layer protocols
Explain SMTP and POP email exchange
Compare FTP active and passive modes
Explain HTTP request/response cycle, methods, and status codes
Understand the role of cookies in HTTP sessions
